verdict.rationale: The evidence includes a Sales Channel Module page, which suggests products in one catalog can be assigned to multiple channels. Webhook events and the customizable framework imply external integrations would have to be built rather than come out of the box. Nothing in the pack shows listing or syncing to external marketplaces, social commerce, or shopping feeds. Missing for 10: documented connectors or sync to external marketplaces, social commerce and shopping feeds; detail on what the Sales Channel Module actually does; any hands-on or community corroboration of multi-channel syndication.
